entities.name: Mehmet I of Karaman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shams al-Dīn Meḥmed I Beg was bey of the Karamanids from 1263 until his death. Karāmān was a Turkish principality in Anatolia in the 13th century. His father was Karim al-Din Karaman.
